summary: v8.12.36 review PASS. Backend: 8/8 pytest cases pass — /api/chat/online returns {online:int, server_time:iso}; with device_id it upserts presence and count >=1; two-device stress (unique device_ids) yielded online>=2 with non-decreasing sequence; empty device_id handled gracefully. Regression /api/search 200s for TRUMP, BTC, AAPL and gibberish. Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844 on preview URL): version label 'Ver 8.12.36' rendered; voice-search-button visible when input empty, tappable without crash (fires Alert on sandbox as expected — no red screen); 🔥 Trending column mounted right after Watchlist showing 12 top-mover AssetCards with %change + WR 30d row (TEAM +93.62% 95%, MDIA +83.21% 40%, INET +54.55% 78%, SGRO +46.77% 84% visible in screenshot); chatroom-online-badge rendered '4' when polling result >0; mic reappears after clearing search; search regression clean (TRUMP=1 card, BTC=6 cards, no red screen).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'Animated: useNativeDriver is not supported because the native animated module is missing.' — pulse animation runs on JS driver on web preview. Cosmetic on web; will use native driver on real device build. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/VoiceSearchButton.tsx:88,94
props.pointerEvents is deprecated on web — should use style.pointerEvents. Reference: /app/frontend/app/index.tsx:953
'shadow*' style props are deprecated on web — migrate to boxShadow (recurring warning across app, not new to v8.12.36).

action_items: (Optional) Migrate `pointerEvents="none"` on the chatroom-online-badge View to `style={{ pointerEvents: 'none' }}` to silence RN Web deprecation warning.
(Optional) Consider `useNativeDriver: false` for VoiceSearchButton pulse on web, or gate by Platform.OS to eliminate the JS-driver warning.
(Optional, app-wide) Migrate remaining `shadow*` props to `boxShadow` for RN Web 0.75+.
critical_code_review_comments: /api/chat/online implementation is clean: single-index count + one upsert, exception-swallowing keeps badge alive on Mongo hiccups. Presence window respected via PRESENCE_WINDOW_SEC.
TrendingColumn is pure-client aggregation across ALL_CATEGORIES, sorted by |change_pct_24h|. Cost-free, updates as dashboard polls. Guards against missing symbol / non-number change_pct_24h.

VoiceSearchButton uses lazy dynamic import for expo-speech-recognition — correctly avoids Expo Go crash; falls back to Web Speech API on web preview; contextual permission flow + settings deeplink covered.
useChatPresence(20s poll) + AppState 'active' refresh + heartbeat gated to premium is a reasonable presence contract; setState skipped when unmounted (cancelledRef).
Minor: /api/chat/online silences all exceptions to `pass` — consider logging with logger.warning so future prod monitoring can trace Mongo failures. Not blocking.
seed_data_creation: Registered two synthetic device_ids (TEST_iter28_A_<ts>, TEST_iter28_B_<ts>) via presence heartbeat; naturally TTL out of the presence window after PRESENCE_WINDOW_SEC. No manual cleanup needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: v8.12.36 (Voice Search + Chatroom Online Badge + Trending Tickers column) verified end-to-end on the preview URL. Live chatroom-online-badge poll returned 4 during test — badge only mounts when >0, so absence in a future run may just mean nobody is online. Backend endpoint /api/chat/online supports no-param read + device_id upsert; the newer /api/search endpoint is stable across TRUMP/BTC/AAPL/gibberish. Voice search dictation cannot be exercised in the sandbox browser (no mic permission grant) — mic button tap-through was confirmed instead.
